music_hubs_layout_patterns_blurb: Pop, ballad, boogie, stride and gospel hand patterns over any chord loop, in any key.
music_hubs_layout_pad_technique_blurb: Strokes, rolls, accents and ghosts on the click, at a level you choose, and rudiments spread across the kit.
music_hubs_layout_aero_fingers_blurb: A setup check, Roland's fingering lessons in order, then scales in every key, crossings over the octave and palm keys and trills.
music_hubs_layout_aero_breath_blurb: Long tones at a level, a long-tone scale, swells, tonguing patterns, swing articulation, bite vibrato and landing intervals on a drone.
music_hubs_layout_pad_grooves_blurb: A repertoire of grooves in six levels, fills that land on the one, playing a bar back, an ostinato under a line, and holding the tempo alone.
music_hubs_layout_beats_blurb: Chop a loop onto the pads and play the slices, Note Repeat builds and rolls, and song-form pieces in one take.
music_hubs_layout_comping_blurb: Shells or rootless voicings on a comping rhythm through the blues, a ii-V-I or any loop.
music_hubs_layout_improvise_blurb: Play anything over the band. Hear the take back as played, then nudged to the grid.
music_hubs_layout_lead_sheets_blurb: The melody in the right hand, roots, shells or chords in the left, from a lead sheet or your own score.

music_hubs_ref_cadence: I, IV, V, I in {key} major.
music_hubs_ref_explorer_title: Chords and scales on the keyboard
music_hubs_ref_explorer_intro: All 17 scales and every chord quality, on any tonic. Labels are degrees from the tonic. Tap Hear it, or play along.
music_hubs_ref_circle_intro: Each step clockwise is a fifth up and one more sharp; counter-clockwise is a fourth up and one more flat, the way ii-V-I chains move. A key's chords are the wedge around it: I, IV and V on the outside, ii, vi and iii inside, vii° at the centre.
music_hubs_ref_circle_pick: Circle of fifths: pick a key
music_hubs_ref_last_sharp: The last sharp, {note}, is a half step below {key}.
music_hubs_ref_second_flat: The second-to-last flat, {note}, names the key.
music_hubs_ref_across_text: {key}: its dominant is the tritone substitute for {chord}7
music_hubs_ref_practise_circle: {link}: key signatures, the order of sharps and flats, and the chords of each key.
music_hubs_ref_fretted_intro: Any chord, everywhere on the neck you can play it. Woodshed works the shapes out from the notes, so open chords, barre chords and closed shapes up the neck all follow the same rules.
music_hubs_ref_vocabulary_intro: The eight jazz families, all on C, with the extensions each one takes.
music_hubs_ref_chord_scales_intro: Which scales sound good over each chord family. Learn the go-to first. Show puts it on the keyboard above.
music_hubs_ref_show_scale: Show C {label} for {chord} on the keyboard
music_hubs_ref_voicings_intro: Four ways to stack a seventh chord. Tap a name to hear it on Cmaj7.
music_hubs_ref_recipe_rooted_use: The plain chord, root at the bottom.
music_hubs_ref_recipe_shell_use: The root, 3rd and 7th: the sound of the chord with nothing extra.
music_hubs_ref_recipe_rootless_a_use: Use when the melody note is the 9th. The left hand takes the root.
music_hubs_ref_recipe_rootless_b_use: Use when the melody note is the 5th. The left hand takes the root.
music_hubs_ref_dominants_intro: Three colours for a V7, from plain to maximum tension. Tap a name to hear it on G7 over a G bass.
music_hubs_ref_upper_intro: Left hand plays the shell (1 3 7), right hand a triad. Tap a triad to hear it over C7.
music_hubs_ref_cycle_intro: The order the voicing drills walk through every key.
music_hubs_ref_standards: {count} standards to learn, swing first, then Latin.
music_hubs_ref_backing_intro: Woodshed doesn't include these recordings. If you have them (or any track you like), import the audio in {link} and it plays under your solo.
music_hubs_mic_will_use: {name} will be used for the microphone.
music_hubs_mic_default_will_use: The default input will be used for the microphone.

music_hubs_mic_echo_off: Echo cancellation off. It applies when the microphone starts.
music_hubs_mic_on: Microphone on ({name}). Play a note to see the level.
music_hubs_mic_failed: The microphone didn't start. Allow it in the browser, then try again.
music_hubs_mic_advice_clipping: Turn the input down or move back. Clipped sound breaks pitch detection.
music_hubs_mic_advice_hot: Back off a little to leave headroom for loud strums.
music_hubs_mic_advice_good: Right where pitch detection works best.
music_hubs_mic_advice_quiet: Move closer or raise the input gain.
music_hubs_mic_names_hint: Start the microphone once and the browser shows each device's name.
music_hubs_mic_blocked: Blocked: allow the microphone for this site in the browser's address bar, then try again.
music_hubs_mic_off_hint: Off. The level and the note you play show here once it starts.
music_hubs_mic_echo_hint: The browser filters Woodshed's own sound out of the microphone, which also blurs your notes. Leave it off for pitch and timing. Turn it on only if the speakers bleed into the mic.
music_hubs_mpc_no_webmidi: Blocked: this browser has no Web MIDI.
music_hubs_mpc_midi_off: Blocked: MIDI is off. Turn it on above.
music_hubs_mpc_no_sysex: Blocked: pad lights (SysEx) weren't allowed, so the MPC can't be linked. Turn MIDI off and on again and allow them.
music_hubs_mpc_no_output: Blocked: the linked output ({name}) isn't connected.
music_hubs_mpc_linked: Linked and holding: Woodshed checks in with {name} every second, on every page, until you unlink.
music_hubs_mpc_not_linked: Not linked: the MPC only sends pad notes while a host keeps talking to it. Press Keep linked.
music_hubs_mpc_intro: Nothing here runs by itself: every frame is sent by a button.
music_hubs_mpc_link_pending: Saved the link, but it can't run yet: {state}
music_hubs_mpc_unlinked: Unlinked: pads switched off and the heartbeat stopped. The MPC will stop sending pad notes.
music_hubs_mpc_rainbow_hint: Pad 1 lit means this is the right output. The rainbow runs red to violet from pad index 0, so you can read the order off the unit.
music_hubs_mpc_advanced: Advanced: the last messages, as bytes
music_hubs_mpc_no_answer: nothing yet: the device has not answered
music_hubs_rig_plug_in: Not connected: plug in and press a key

music_hubs_rig_midi_off_page: MIDI is off on this page until you turn it on again.

music_hubs_data_rest_untouched: The rest of this site, including the PDF reader, is untouched.
music_hubs_data_reset_hint: Deletes every session, take, sample and setting Woodshed keeps in this browser. Nothing else in Woodshed deletes your data.
music_hubs_tuner_verdict_good: In tune {pct}% of the time. Centred and steady.
music_hubs_tuner_verdict_steady_sharp: Steady, but {cents} cents sharp. Tune down, then hold it again.
music_hubs_tuner_verdict_steady_flat: Steady, but {cents} cents flat. Tune up, then hold it again.
music_hubs_tuner_verdict_wanders: The pitch wanders. Hold one even note, a little softer.
music_hubs_tuner_verdict_wanders_sharp: The pitch wanders, {cents} cents sharp on average. Hold one even note, a little softer.
music_hubs_tuner_verdict_wanders_flat: The pitch wanders, {cents} cents flat on average. Hold one even note, a little softer.
music_hubs_tuner_verdict_longer: In tune {pct}% of the time. Hold it longer in the green band.
music_hubs_tuner_scope_hint: Press Play drone to see it.
music_hubs_drone_sine_hint: A pure tone: the easiest to hear beats against.
music_hubs_drone_cello_hint: A bowed, filtered tone with some body.
music_hubs_drone_shruti_hint: Stacks the fifth and the octave, like a tanpura.
music_hubs_drone_blocked: Sound is blocked. Press Play drone again to allow it.
music_hubs_drone_scale_hint: Gold pads with a dot are in {tonic} major. ♭3 = minor third above {tonic}. Tap a pad to change the tonic.
music_hubs_tuner_listening: Listening. Play one note and let it ring.
music_hubs_tuner_privacy: The microphone only listens while this is on. Nothing is recorded.
music_hubs_tuner_target_hint: Target note. Any note tunes to the nearest note. Pick one to aim at it in the octave you play.
music_hubs_tuner_string_near: String {n}, {note}, nearest to what you are playing. Play reference.
music_hubs_tuner_trace_label: Pitch over the last 10 seconds, with the in-tune band of ±{cents} cents
music_hubs_tuner_band_key: Green band: in tune, within ±{cents} cents
music_hubs_tuner_last_10: last 10 seconds, now at the right
music_hubs_tuner_stat_in_tune_title: Share of the last 10 seconds within ±{cents} cents
music_hubs_tuner_stat_hold_title: The longest stretch in tune without a break
music_hubs_tuner_stat_steady_title: How little the pitch wobbles, wherever it sits
music_hubs_tuner_stat_drift_title: Average distance from the note: plus is sharp, minus is flat
music_hubs_tuner_count_once: In tune and Hold count once the note sits in the green band.
music_hubs_tuner_hold_hint: Hold one note steadily. In tune %, hold, steadiness and drift fill in as you play.
music_hubs_tuner_footer: In tune means within {cents} cents, everywhere on this page.
music_hubs_tuner_footer_trace: The trace shows the last 10 seconds.
music_hubs_tuner_footer_hold: Hold a note in tune for {seconds} second and the ring closes. Weak or noisy sound holds the last reading instead of flickering.
music_hubs_tuner_keys_label: Keyboard with the note heard marked
music_hubs_tuner_nothing_clear: Nothing clear yet. One note at a time, close to the microphone.
music_hubs_tuner_start_hint: Start listening, then play a single note.
music_hubs_drone_about_after: are the seven notes of {tonic} major. The numbers count steps up from {tonic}: 5 is the fifth, ♭ lowers a step by a half step, ♯ raises it.
music_hubs_audio_clip: At {gain} the loudest moment would clip (the take peaks at {peak} dB).
music_hubs_audio_clip_safe: At {gain} the loudest moment would clip (the take peaks at {peak} dB). {safe} or less stays clean.
music_hubs_kit_list_only: {name} (every pad is taken, so it's in the sample list only)
music_hubs_kit_need_sample: Put at least one sample on a pad before exporting.
music_hubs_kit_file_missing: The file for "{name}" is missing from this browser's storage.
music_hubs_live_blocked: Sound is blocked. Tap for sound in the top bar, then try again.

match.countPlural=one: Recording: {count} bar at {bpm} BPM, round and round. Each pass adds what you play. One voice a pass works best.
match.countPlural=other: Recording: {count} bars at {bpm} BPM, round and round. Each pass adds what you play. One voice a pass works best.

music_hubs_live_good: A {bars}-bar loop in {passes} passes, in time, in {minutes} minutes.
music_hubs_live_few: {kept} passes kept: build it in at least {passes} (kick, snare, hats).
music_hubs_live_late_undo: A pass from the third on was undone: aim to keep every pass once the groove is there.
music_hubs_live_off_grid: The hits wandered off the grid: steady the passes, or set Quantise to 50%.
music_hubs_live_slow: Built in {minutes} minutes: aim for {max} or less.

match.countPlural=one: {count} bar at {bpm} BPM: the beat's length (set on the beat grid) and the song's tempo.
match.countPlural=other: {count} bars at {bpm} BPM: the beat's length (set on the beat grid) and the song's tempo.

music_hubs_live_repeat_hint_on: Note repeat: hold a pad and it repeats on the loop's grid; your pads send aftertouch, so pressure sets the level. Keep this loop scores the build: in time, at least {passes} passes, no undo from the third on, {minutes} minutes or less.
music_hubs_live_repeat_hint_off: Note repeat: hold a pad and it repeats on the loop's grid; pressure sets the level when the pads send aftertouch. Keep this loop scores the build: in time, at least {passes} passes, no undo from the third on, {minutes} minutes or less.
music_hubs_live_pads: MPC pads, bank A, playing the kit. Computer keys Z X C V play the bottom row.
music_hubs_tracks_blocked: Sound is blocked. Tap for sound in the top bar, then play again.
music_hubs_tracks_playing_alone: Playing {name} on its own. Play all brings the rest back.
music_hubs_tracks_loop_set: {name} repeats its first {bars} through all {total} bars of the song. Notes after bar {last} aren't heard.
music_hubs_tracks_loop_off: {name} plays as written, without a loop.
music_hubs_tracks_beat_muted: Beat muted. The melodies keep playing.
music_hubs_tracks_added: Added {name}. Draw its notes in the editor below.
music_hubs_tracks_added_chords: Added {name}: {chords}, one chord a bar on E-Piano.
music_hubs_tracks_saved_beat: Saved the beat {name} to the library. Add it to any song from Add from library.
music_hubs_tracks_saved_melody: Saved {name} to the library. Add it to any song from Add from library.
music_hubs_tracks_beat_grew: The beat is {bars}. The new bar starts as a copy of the last one.
music_hubs_tracks_beat_shrank: The beat is {bars}. It repeats to fill the song.
music_hubs_tracks_beat_add: Add a bar to the beat
music_hubs_mr_limit: The take reached the 60-minute limit and was saved.
music_hubs_mr_nothing: Nothing was played, so no take was saved.
music_hubs_mr_not_saved: The take didn't save: {reason}. Record it again.
music_hubs_mr_to_songs: {name} is saved to Song practice, snapped to sixteenths at {bpm} BPM.

match.countPlural=one: {count} note so far. Takes stop by themselves at 60 minutes.
match.countPlural=other: {count} notes so far. Takes stop by themselves at 60 minutes.

music_hubs_mr_idle: Record from a MIDI keyboard or pads, the keys below, or your computer keyboard.
music_hubs_mr_no_webmidi: Web MIDI is unavailable in this browser. Play the keys below or your computer keyboard.
music_hubs_mr_note_placeholder: Add a note: what to fix next time
music_hubs_mr_none: No MIDI takes yet. Press the record button and play.
music_hubs_mr_compare_intro: Lines the second take up with the first (a slower or faster take is stretched to fit) and counts the notes that match in pitch and time.
music_hubs_bg_playing_alone: Playing the beat on its own at {bpm} BPM.
music_hubs_bg_own_bar: Bar {n} is its own now, a copy to change.
music_hubs_bg_preset_loaded: {name}: {hits} hits over {bars}. Change anything you like.
music_hubs_bg_repeating: , repeating to fill the song's {count} bars
music_hubs_bg_rows_kit: Rows play the samples in {kit}, built-in drums elsewhere. Tap a step to add or remove a hit.
music_hubs_bg_rows_builtin: Rows play the built-in drums. Tap a step to add or remove a hit.
music_hubs_bg_keys: Arrow keys move around the grid, Enter or Space toggles a step.
music_hubs_kp_made: Made {name}. Import samples to fill its pads.
music_hubs_kp_choke: Choke group: pads in one group cut each other off
music_hubs_kp_no_samples: No samples yet. Until a pad has one, the beat plays the built-in drums.
music_hubs_kp_how_names_body: Import WAV, AIFF, FLAC, MP3 or OGG. A file called "Kick_01" or "HiHat Open" lands on the matching pad by itself; anything else takes the next free pad of the bank on screen. Empty pads play the built-in drum named on them. Kits stay in this browser.
music_hubs_kp_advanced: Advanced: send the kit to an MPC
music_hubs_kp_advanced_body: Saves a drum program file (.xpm) and a Samples folder, named after the kit. Copy the folder to the MPC's SD card or drive and load the program. This export has not yet been checked on a real MPC One+.
music_hubs_ar_mic_on: Microphone on. Check the meter, then record.
music_hubs_ar_not_saved: The take was recorded but didn't save: {reason}. It stays on this page until you save again.
music_hubs_ar_missing_storage: The file for {name} is missing from this browser's storage.
music_hubs_ar_advice_clipping: the loudest notes distort. Turn the input down or move the mic away.
music_hubs_ar_advice_hot: fine, but there is little room left for a loud accent.
music_hubs_ar_advice_quiet: move closer or turn the input up. A quiet take can be lifted on playback, but its noise comes up with it.
music_hubs_ar_press_record: Press Record to start, or arm the microphone first to check the level.
music_hubs_ar_trace_rec: Recording: the take as it comes in
music_hubs_ar_trace_live: Live input: play a little to check the level
music_hubs_ar_joins: . It joins the list when you stop.
music_hubs_ar_louder: Plays {db} dB louder here, so you can hear a quiet take
music_hubs_ar_gain_hint: Gain changes only how a take plays back here. The recording stays as it was.
music_hubs_ar_none: No audio takes yet. Arm the microphone, then press Record.
music_hubs_pr_picked_melodies: {name} picked: you hear it with the melodies, and new notes go on it.
music_hubs_pr_picked_parts: {name} picked: you hear it with the parts, and new notes go on it.
music_hubs_pr_dropped_melodies: {name} put down: Play melodies leaves it out.
music_hubs_pr_dropped_parts: {name} put down: Play parts leaves it out.
music_hubs_pr_only_one: {name} is the only one picked. Pick another before putting it down.
music_hubs_pr_in_loop: , in the loop, so every repeat changes
music_hubs_pr_resize_loop: Resize notes in the loop, the first {count} bars. The repeats follow.
music_hubs_pr_resize_mode: Resize mode: drag a note of the selected voice to change its length. Switch to Draw to add notes.
music_hubs_pr_cursor_on_note: Put the cursor on a note to change its length.
music_hubs_pr_grid: Note grid for {name}. Arrow keys move the cursor, Enter adds or removes a note, Shift with Left or Right changes its length, [ and ] change its velocity.
music_hubs_pr_empty: Click a cell to draw a note. It plays on the loop with the beat.
music_hubs_pr_hint_resize: Drag a note to change its length.
music_hubs_pr_hint_draw: Click a cell to add a note, click a note to remove it.
music_hubs_pr_applied: Every note on {name} now has velocity {n}.
music_hubs_cr_take_gone: That take is no longer in Record.
music_hubs_cr_take_added: Added {name} as a new melody, {count} notes snapped to sixteenths at {bpm} BPM.
music_hubs_cr_playing: Playing {name}: {bars} at {bpm} BPM, on a loop.

match.countPlural=one: {count} note past the end went with the bar.
match.countPlural=other: {count} notes past the end went with the bar.

music_hubs_cr_new_song: New song: an empty beat and one empty melody. It isn't saved until you press Save.
music_hubs_cr_saved_copy: Saved a copy, {name}. Changes now go to the copy.
music_hubs_cr_removed: Removed {name} from your songs. It's still open: Save puts it back.
music_hubs_cr_no_notes: The melodies have no notes yet. MIDI export covers the melodies.
music_hubs_cr_add_first: Add a few notes or beats first.
music_hubs_cr_downloading_wav: Downloading {name}, one pass of the song with the beat.
music_hubs_cr_wav_failed: The WAV didn't render: {reason}. Try WAV again.
music_hubs_cr_add_bar: Add a bar to the song
music_hubs_cr_intro: Build a beat and melodies that loop together, then jam over them.
music_hubs_cr_export_hint: MIDI has the melodies. WAV is one pass of everything you hear.
music_hubs_cr_save_then_new: Save, then start a new one
music_hubs_kits_intro: Your own sounds on pads. The beat in Create plays them.
music_hubs_ref_page_intro: Every chord, scale and key in one place, to look up while you write or practise.
music_hubs_ref_page_status: Showing the chord and scale reference.
